title_en: Measuring instruments, lamps and signalling devices
title_fr: Appareils de mesure, lampes et dispositifs de signalisation
blurb: Measuring instruments (ammeters, voltmeters, recorders), integrating meters, clocks, lamps, indicators and signalling/alarm devices. Builds on the measuring-relay block symbols in [[60617-7]] and qualifying symbols in [[60617-2]].
